In 2014, NASA awarded Boeing $4.2 BILLION to develop Starliner

SpaceX received just $2.6 BILLION for Crew Dragon

Now look at the results:

• Boeing Starliner: Just one crewed flight and got two astronauts stuck on the ISS for over 9 months in space before SpaceX sent Dragon to rescue them

• SpaceX Crew Dragon: 21 crewed missions since 2020, carrying astronauts to orbit for NASA and private customers, saving NASA billions of dollars

Boeing received $1.6 BILLION more in the original NASA contract

Yet SpaceX ended up bringing Boeing's own astronauts back to Earth
